alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous Bullet Train Being Built at ICF and BEML
bullets: India’s first domestically designed bullet train (B28) under construction at Integral Coach Factory (ICF) and BEML in Bengaluru, designed for 280 km/h.
First body frame completed and undergoing structural testing; track trials expected by mid‑2027.
Represents India’s inaugural high‑speed train built to international standards.

alert_news.title: India's First Bullet Train Project 80% Complete, Surat–Vapi Section to Open 2027
bullets: Mumbai–Ahmedabad High‑Speed Rail (MAHSR) corridor, 508 km long, 80 % construction completed; first operational section Surat–Vapi slated for August 2027.
Trains designed for 350 km/h (operational 320 km/h), marking India’s first bullet train project.
Sets a template for future high‑speed corridors across the country.

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenously Discovered Insecticide Molecule Pioxaniliprole Launched as Pioxazon
bullets: Pioxaniliprole, India’s first discovered insecticide molecule, commercialised in Pioxazon for rice, maize and Bengal gram.
Registered by the Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee, it is the first product to complete the discovery‑to‑commercialisation cycle in India.
Offers rapid absorption, rainfastness and high efficacy against key pests such as Yellow Stem Borer, Fall Armyworm and Pod Borer.

alert_news.title: Chhattisgarh's Khaira becomes India's first 100% solar village under PM Surya Ghar yojana
bullets: Khaira village, Rajnandgaon district, Chhattisgarh, first village to achieve 100% rooftop solar coverage under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, 141 households
Aggregate clean energy capacity 282 kW (2 kW per home), zero out‑of‑pocket cost for residents, enabled by net‑metering framework

alert_news.title: Assam signs MoU with Belgian firm's subsidiary for India's first public proton beam therapy unit
bullets: Assam government signed MoU with Ion Beam Applications SA subsidiary to set up India's first public proton beam therapy centre in Guwahati, cost Rs 600 crore
First public sector proton therapy unit in India, previously available only in private hospitals, aimed at providing advanced cancer treatment to children and the general population

alert_news.title: India's First Woman Wrestling World Champion
bullets: First Indian woman to win a Senior World Wrestling Championships title in the women's 59kg freestyle at the 2026 championships in Astana, Kazakhstan.
Achieved by Manisha Bhanwala from Haryana, breaking gender barriers in Indian wrestling.
Sets a precedent for Indian women in international wrestling competitions.

alert_news.title: Karnataka to launch India's first mobile biodiversity museum
bullets: India’s first mobile biodiversity museum – a Volvo bus touring Karnataka to showcase Western Ghats flora and fauna
Operates on roof‑mounted solar panels, zero‑carbon footprint; project budgeted at Rs 1 crore
